string.text: When a faction-enemy hits any member of a squad, the entire squad is force-disclosed to the shooter on hit #1: each online squadmate gets the shooter pinned as hostile in their relation registry, has their memory of the shooter enabled, and is flagged as combat-active so the engine propagates the shooter into their visual/sound/hit memory. Extends the engine's audio-range squad disclosure to distant patrol members and suppressed-weapon victims.

Master toggle. When off, the npc_on_hit_callback handler skips; no force_set_goodwill, no enable_memory_object, no register_in_combat calls. The squad-memory substrate stays available for other systems to read but is not populated by hits. Default: on.

How long a per-shooter entry stays in the squad's combat memory after the last hit from that shooter. Lower = squads forget snipers quickly. Higher = sustained pressure keeps disclosed shooters in memory. Default: 60.
Per-stalker healing behaviors. Each section below tunes one subsystem.

Master toggle for the whole Healing feature: heal rate patch and per-rank healing-charge override. When off, vanilla xr_eat_medkit behavior runs unmodified. Toggle requires game restart. The medkit DLTX overlay is boot-time and always active. Default: on.

Vanilla xr_eat_medkit's [plugin] section ships without the medkits / bandages item lists, so the consumption loop iterates over nothing and stalkers never use the kits in their inventory. AlifeTactics restores the missing lists through a DLTX overlay on ai_tweaks/xr_eat_medkit.ltx covering the vanilla medkits and the bandage. Data-layer fix loaded at boot; no runtime toggle.

Multiplies the per-tick HP recovery in xr_eat_medkit's heal_hp loop. Vanilla restores 0.05 HP per tick for 13 ticks (0.65 HP total) before the heal cycle exits. At 2.0x each tick restores 0.10 HP, so the heal completes in fewer ticks. At 0.5x each tick restores 0.025 HP. Default: 1.0.

Probability that a novice-rank stalker is granted the lifetime healing_charge token at first spawn. The charge fires once if the stalker drops below the medkit_health threshold without a medkit in inventory. Vanilla rolls 50% for every rank. Default: 50.

Stalkers in vanilla fire with one shared dispersion - the engine's rank curve is dead at Anomaly's rank values. AlifeTactics restores per-rank scaling so masters shoot tighter than novices. Tune each tier below.
Master toggle for the per-shot accuracy hook. When off, the engine's default (flat) dispersion applies to every stalker regardless of rank. Default: on.
Dispersion for novice-rank stalkers. Lower = tighter shot cone = more lethal. 1.00 matches vanilla engine baseline. Default: 1.00.
Dispersion for legend-rank stalkers (max tier). Default: 0.38.

Rotates squad members through the engine's DetourEnemy action while the squad is in active combat (a faction-enemy hit landed within the last 60s). Every 20 seconds, one non-commander member of each engaged squad has their visual memory of the primary shooter briefly disabled (4s), which makes the engine's combat sub-planner pick DetourEnemy: the engine handles its own vertex pick, pathing, and fire. Members rotate across ticks so the squad spreads around the engagement without forced movement, GOAP injection, or combat-planner blocking.
Master toggle. When off, the per-squad tick still fires but skips all designations; the engine's vanilla combat planner runs unmodified. Default: on.

Forces sniper and launcher carriers into crouch when the engine selects a static-cover action (KillEnemy, LookOut, HoldPosition, WaitInCover, HoldAmbushLocation). Crouching gives a lower silhouette, tighter dispersion, and a stable firing position from cover. Hooks the engine's CombatSetBodyState functor; passes through unchanged for other weapon kinds. The weapon-kind check reads the active item's "kind" field directly (w_sniper / w_launcher), no substrate dependency.
Master toggle. When off, the engine's chosen body state passes through unchanged. Default: on.

Debug and development tools. DEBUG enables structured tracing of every system: hit disclosure events, engaged_until updates, maneuver evaluator/dispatch, stance overrides, healing ticks, accuracy per-shot. Written to alifetactics.log. Has performance cost.
Controls log verbosity. ERROR: crashes only. WARN: anomalies. INFO: module init and patch installs. DEBUG: full per-event tracing.
